delete_space_hint: Only an empty space can be deleted. If it reports content, move its bookmarks out or unbind its devices first.
delete_space_not_empty: This space is still referenced by something else; clear that up first.
blocked_content: It still contains bookmarks or folders. Move or delete them first.
blocked_binding: Devices are still bound to it. Unbind them on the Devices page first.
blocked_backup: It still has backups. Delete those first.
blocked_publication: It is still published in the plaza. Unpublish it first.
blocked_schedule: It still has scheduled jobs. Stop those first.
name_invalid: The name must not be empty or contain path characters.
